warnings: FOOTING MARKS ARE SIZE-BASED, NOT NUMBERED. This sheet has no F1/F2-style marks: every footing is labelled '(F<width>x<length>),<column mark>', e.g. (F0.80x0.80),C1A. element_id therefore carries the printed size mark verbatim (F0.60x0.60 / F0.80x0.80 / F1.00x1.00) and the column mark is kept in column_mark. 3 footing sizes x 2 column marks appear; 20 footings total.

LAYOUT IS NOT A FULL 4 x 6 GRID. Rows F, E, D, C carry 4 footings each (grids 1-4); row B has only B-2 and B-3 (เฉลียง porch columns); row A has only A-3 and A-4 (carport columns). Verified at 3x zoom -- the row-A pair sits on grids 3 and 4, not 2 and 3 (a low-zoom first read got this wrong and was corrected against the grid-line overlay).

COLUMN MARK CONFLICT WITH S-03 AT C-1 AND C-4: this sheet prints (F0.80x0.80),C1 at both, but S-03's pile-footing alternative prints F4,C1A at the same two positions (re-verified at ~5x on both sheets). The other 18 positions carry identical column marks on both sheets (C1A on rows F/B/A, C1 on rows E/D and C-2/C-3). The column above a given position should not depend on which foundation alternative is built, so one sheet carries a misprint -- undecidable 1-vs-1 at Stage 1; recorded as printed here, flagged on the two elements, and handed to Stage 2 via phase_note (S-10/S-07 hold the evidence).

This sheet and S-03 are ALTERNATIVE foundation schemes for the same house (ฐานรากแผ่ spread vs ฐานรากตอกเข็ม driven-pile) -- the BOQ section of this set is split into the same two groups (แบบฐานรากแผ่ PNG52-61, แบบฐานรากเสาเข็ม PNG62-71 per the Stage-0 manifest). Both plans place footings at the identical 20 grid positions.

All 20 footings sit exactly ON named grid intersections -- no dummy grids are used at foundation level (the 5 dummy lines in the grid master exist for superstructure beams on S-04/S-05 only). No drawing break lines on this sheet (checked at ~4.5x, see grid master).
Both dimension chains on this sheet close: 3.20+3.20+3.20 = 9.60 printed, 3.15+1.80+3.60+2.00+4.00 = 14.55 printed (bottom-to-top). This sheet is the grid master's primary source.
